author: HaardhikK
name: WinnerArch Int6+Zstd — 11L 512dim GQA, EMA+SWA, Late QAT
blurb: 11 independent transformer layers, dim=512, 8 heads, 4 KV heads (GQA), 3x MLP ReLU^2, int6+zstd compression (~27M params in <16MB). EMA(0.997)+SWA(every 40) stacking, late QAT at scale<0.18, BigramHash, Value Embeddings(layers 8,9,10), XSA last 4 layers, partial RoPE 16/64 dims, Muon optimizer.
